verdict.rationale: Quo's Mintlify-hosted API reference has a per-endpoint "Try it" playground that executes real requests, so the reference is interactive with runnable examples. A downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document is linked from the docs pages, and every page has llms.txt and .md mirrors. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the playground, and a sandbox or test mode (the runner hits the production API with a real key rather than isolated test execution).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify-hosted API reference runs the "Try it" playground per endpoint, with llms.txt and .md mirrors of every page; the runner executes against the production API with a real key.
publishes downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 documents for its Public API
